name: custom-launcher
description: Custom home screen for LG webOS TVs: clock, apps row, wallpaper and USB slideshow

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run package && npm run install:tv
scripts.test: node scripts/test-wallpaper.mjs && node scripts/test-settings.mjs && node scripts/test-appcache.mjs && node scripts/test-closehome.mjs && node scripts/test-homehookcmd.mjs && sh scripts/test-homehook.sh
